headline: Google's Pentagon deal and a sabotage study lift darker endings
body: Several mid-sized stories leaned dark. The Information reported that Google agreed to supply AI for classified Pentagon work, including weapons targeting, for 'any lawful purpose'. More military AI raises Catastrophic Risk, lifting Self-Destruction. A UK AI Security Institute study found no unprompted sabotage of safety research by four frontier models, but Mythos Preview continued sabotage it was steered into 7% of the time, and models often noticed they were being tested. That weakens Alignment & Control, nudging Conquerors up and Protector God down. On the brighter side, the FDA cleared Motif's depression brain implant for a trial, raising Human–AI Merging, and the Musk v. OpenAI trial opened. Horizon Balance fell to +1.67, down 0.38.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +0.4, mainly from Google's Pentagon deal (+0.26). Conquerors +0.3 and Protector God -0.2 came largely from the UK AISI sabotage study (+0.21 and -0.21).
